title: What raised the risk of a retained sponge or instrument
description: Bar chart of risk ratios from Gawande and colleagues' case-control study of 54 patients with retained sponges or instruments in Massachusetts, 1985 to 2001: an emergency operation 8.8, an unplanned change in the operation 4.1, and each one-unit increase in body-mass index 1.1.
heading: RISK RATIO FOR A RETAINED ITEM · GAWANDE 2003
